Doorstep basket prawn toast.d: Ginger and scallion blended in, sesame pressed on, fried golden and cut in triangles. Sweet chili sauce to dip.

Bagel chips and schmear.d: Yesterday's batch sliced thin and baked crisp, with cream cheese whipped up with chives and lemon zest.
Bagel chips and schmear.note: Trays serve twelve. Call by noon.

Peter's loft steak sandwich.d: Seared sirloin sliced thin, slow-cooked onions, melted Swiss and horseradish mayo on toasted sourdough.
Peter's loft steak sandwich.note: Named for one of our regulars.

Baby Mary's bedtime vanilla custard.d: Stirred slow on the stove until thick and smooth. Warm or chilled, by the cup.

Night-feed bourbon milk punch.d: Cold whole milk shaken frothy with vanilla and a spoon of honey, nutmeg grated over.
